verdict.rationale: YYLO's own integrations doc says it can bring GitHub issues into its kanban and return completed responses to the source thread. That is a real issue-tracker link, but a narrow one: ingest plus reply-back, not agents managing tickets directly. Its Ledger is an internal Git-native tracker, not a connection to an external one. Missing for 10: Jira, Linear, ClickUp and Monday.com connectors; evidence that agents can directly create, update or transition tickets in an external tracker; setup or auth docs; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect issue trackers like Jira, Linear, ClickUp, or Monday.com so agents can manage tickets directly

citations.quote: Bring Slack messages or GitHub issues into kanban and return completed responses to their source thread.
